data.long_meaning: Tanu is a Sanskrit name which means 'Jewel' or 'Delight'. In Hindu mythology, Tanu is the name of Lord Shiva's wife, Parvati, who is the goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. The name Tanu is believed to bring happiness, beauty, and grace to the one who bears it. The name Tanu carries the meaning “Jewel, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tanu usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tanu is a spiritual name that represents the inner beauty and grace of a person. It is a name that signifies the divine feminine energy and is believed to bring happiness, joy, and inner peace.
data.etymology: Tanu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Delight.”
